evidence: src/infrastructure/in-memory-product-repository.ts: class InMemoryProductRepository implements ProductRepository and stores products in a private Map<string, Product>, which is persistence (infrastructure).
findByIds only looks up stored products, using new Set(ids) to skip duplicate ids. This is a storage access detail.
findAll and save only read and write the Map. They hold no domain invariants or use-case orchestration.
parsedVerdict.reasoning: The file is an in-memory persistence adapter. It implements the domain-declared ProductRepository port. Its only responsibilities are storing products in a Map and getting them back: find by ids (with de-duplication), find all, and save. All of these are persistence concerns, which fit the infrastructure layer. The file has no business rules (no pricing, no validation, no invariants), no application orchestration and no presentation logic. Removing duplicate ids in findByIds is a lookup detail, not a business rule.
